'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|We've come a long way, haven't we? You've learned a great deal. Now you can teach the newcomers of Tarkov a thing or two yourself. Show them that without armor, they shouldn't even think about stepping outside their hiding place.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 10 PMCs without using any armor or helmets on [[Woods]]

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|You made the old man proud. Carry the lessons forward.}}

==Guide==
This quest takes place on [[Woods]]. You are required to kill 15 PMCs without wearing any [[armor vest]], [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]], [[Headwear#Armored|armored headwear]] or [[Face cover#Armored|armored face cover]]. Armored [[Eyewear#Armored|eyewear]] is allowed.

'''Bug:''' The [[ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (MultiCam)]] is currently considered armored for this quest even when it's not.

If you want to protect yourself during this quest you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a PMC.
